A five-element set K={5,6,7,8,9} is given. Drawing each number from this set is equally likely. From set K we draw with replacement, one after another, two numbers, and write them down in the order drawn. Calculate the probability of event A, that the sum of the drawn numbers is an even number. Show your working.

tasks.summary_pl: 3 wybiegi, siatka $36$m. Oblicz $x,y$ dla max pola (suma)
tasks.summary_en: 3 enclosures, fencing $36$m. Find $x,y$ for max area (sum)
tasks.statement_en: In an animal shelter, on a flat surface, a mesh fence must be built to separate three identical enclosures with common internal walls. The base of each of these three enclosures is a rectangle (as shown in the figure) [Figure: three adjacent identical rectangular enclosures in a row viewed from above, each of width y and total height x]. 36 running meters of mesh must be used to build this fence. Calculate the dimensions x and y of one enclosure for which the sum of the base areas of these three enclosures will be greatest. In your calculations, ignore the width of the entrance to each enclosure. Show your working.
